coverageDispositions.reason: Actual HTTP binds 127.0.0.1 and closes server; DNS and production network excluded.
Fixture explicitly uses isolated cleartext; no certificates or TLS required.
No proxy, CDN, gateway or load balancer in supplied fixture.
Editor permission and tenant-inclusive predicates; spoofed headers ignored. Registry is fixture authority only.
Real HTTP/1.1 route and JSON response; GET preserved; other protocols excluded.
Allowlisted fields, null/absence and version-only semantics verified. Other CRUD unchanged.
2048 encoded bytes; 5000ms body timer; schema/media/error codes.
Identity -> permission -> media/bytes/schema -> SQL -> public projection; no framework introduced.
Actual runtime reported; per-body memory/time bounded; global process capacity not assessed.
Original tenant/id primary key and seed behavior preserved; no migration.
Fixed SQL identifiers; explicit tenant predicate and public projection; actual read plan recorded at N=3.
One-row CAS includes version and increments atomically; actual same-version HTTP competition. Multi-row invariants excluded.
No SQL roles/GRANT in SQLite or administrative change required; file-owner trust disclosed.
DELETE journal/synchronous settings observed and close/reopen verified; crash/power-loss/replication excluded.
Fixture has no cache or derived read model.
Synchronous database operation has no broker, CDC or external effect.
No durable background task or schedule requested.
SQLite file belongs to L14; no uploaded files or specialized store.
Only local HTTP/SQLite; no external API/webhook/MCP path.
Enforces task payload budget only. No throughput/cost/scaling assertion; global socket admission unverified.
Reopened isolated database preserves winning mutation and tenant state; backup/crash/full-disk recovery not claimed.
Task requests correctness evidence, which is retained. No logging, metrics or audit subsystem exists or was requested.
No deployment/infrastructure/build pipeline change; native built-ins require no installation.
Mass assignment denied, safe public projection/errors, no new dependency or secret transmission. Production credential lifecycle excluded.

decisions.mechanism: Allowlist version/title/note; trim title; preserve absent fields with CASE flags; null only note; public RETURNING projection.
decisions.limit: Title 120 and note 500 UTF-16 code units; positive safe integer version; body 2048 bytes.
decisions.failure: 400 invalid/unknown fields;409 stale; no partial mutation; lost acknowledgement requires GET reconciliation.
decisions.verification: 3 final actual HTTP repetitions; boundary, null, absence, invalid, stale and projection checks pass.

decisions.mechanism: Existing trusted registry -> editor flag -> tenant-inclusive SQL. Headers carry no tenant authority.
decisions.limit: Three fixed fixture identities; file owner can bypass app checks; no production credential lifecycle.
decisions.failure: 401 unknown identity;403 reader;404 tenant-local absence; no foreign-row disclosure.
decisions.verification: HTTP denial, spoofed headers, both tenants sharing t1, south-only object and reopen checks pass.

decisions.mechanism: One atomic UPDATE WHERE tenant/id/version RETURNING; increment version inside SQL.
decisions.limit: One synchronous process and one file-backed SQLite connection per service; no multi-row invariant or distributed deployment claim.
decisions.failure: One same-version winner, one409; busy/unexpected storage errors safe500 and no automatic retry.
decisions.verification: Two concurrent HTTP requests repeated in three fresh final runs; durable winner and version observed.

decisions.mechanism: Media gate, declared-length early reject, streamed byte count before JSON parse, strict UTF-8 decode, schema gate, 5s body deadline, close response connection.
decisions.limit: 2048 accumulated encoded bytes; network chunk/native/socket memory is outside accumulation cap; no global admission limit.
decisions.failure: 400 malformed/schema/deadline;413 oversized;415 unsupported type/encoding; request consumption paused on error.
decisions.verification: Malformed, media, encoding, declared/chunked/multibyte oversize and exact boundary pass; slow-body fault evidence retained.

decisions.mechanism: Copy original fixture; preserve GET projection/schema; retain runnable built-ins-only verification using real TCP HTTP and file-backed SQLite.
decisions.limit: Node24.12.0 / SQLite3.50.4 / Windowsx64; DELETE journal synchronous2; close/reopen is not power-loss recovery.
decisions.failure: Original and failed instrumentation retained; required runtime/HTTP/reopen behavior would remain FAIL or UNVERIFIED if absent.
decisions.verification: Initial9 and three final10-check runs pass; complete stdout/stderr and database files retained.

decisions.mechanism: Explicit24-area dispositions separate from acceptance outcomes; decisions state mechanisms, limits, failures and evidence.
decisions.limit: Proportional isolated fixture scope; no production/performance/cost/quality guarantee.
decisions.failure: Unavailable exact first-call timestamp, tokens and cost remain unknown; no unsupported claims.
decisions.verification: Output structural checks validate24 unique areas, declared vocabularies, six requirement IDs and evidence files.
